name: Mesa Verde
significance: Exceptional preservation of Ancestral Puebloan culture
description: Ancient Ancestral Puebloan cliff dwellings and archaeological sites.

name: Cahokia Mounds
significance: Largest prehistoric Native American city north of Mexico
description: Largest pre-Columbian settlement north of Mexico, with over 120 earthen mounds.

name: Chaco Canyon
significance: Center of ceremonial, trade, and administrative activities
description: Major center of Ancestral Puebloan culture with monumental architecture and astronomical alignments.

name: Poverty Point
significance: One of North America's most impressive ancient engineering feats
description: Large prehistoric earthwork site built by the Poverty Point culture.

name: Serpent Mound
significance: Largest surviving prehistoric effigy mound in the world
description: A 1,348-foot-long prehistoric effigy mound in the shape of a serpent.

name: Hopewell Culture Site
significance: Center of extensive trade network and ceremonial activity
description: Complex of earthworks and mounds built by the Hopewell culture.

name: Taos Pueblo
significance: One of the oldest continuously inhabited communities in the United States
description: Ancient pueblo continuously inhabited for over 1,000 years.

name: Bandelier National Monument
description: Cliff dwellings and rock art of Ancestral Puebloan people in New Mexico.

name: Moundville
description: Second-largest Mississippian site in the US with 29 platform mounds.

name: Aztec Ruins
description: Misnamed ruins of an Ancestral Puebloan great house with over 400 rooms.

name: Ocmulgee Mounds
description: Ceremonial mounds and earth lodge from the Mississippian period in Georgia.

name: Effigy Mounds
description: Over 200 prehistoric mounds including animal effigy mounds in Iowa.

name: Casa Grande
description: Four-story ancient structure built by the Hohokam people in Arizona.

name: Spiro Mounds
description: Important Mississippian culture site with burial mounds and artifacts in Oklahoma.

name: Etowah Mounds
description: Major Mississippian culture site with six earthen mounds in Georgia.

name: Hovenweep
description: Six groups of Ancestral Puebloan villages with distinctive tower structures.

name: Canyon de Chelly
description: Spectacular cliff dwellings in a dramatic canyon setting in Arizona.

name: Tonto National Monument
description: Two cliff dwellings occupied by the Salado culture in Arizona.
